title: Spider-Man: Beyond the Spider-Verse
tagline: Miles is still trying to get home.
summary: Sony Pictures Animation schedules the third Spider-Verse film for June 18, 2027, with Bob Persichetti and Justin K. Thompson directing. It has not been released. Earlier announced dates were delays, not alternate premieres.
releaseNote: Sony Pictures Animation lists a United States theatrical date of June 18, 2027. The film is upcoming. Do not treat earlier slipped dates as the premiere.
